verdict.rationale: The README documents auto-activation: after install, you ask for a logo in a new session and the agent picks up the skill from its description. The skill uses the standard SKILL.md Agent Skills format, so this works in any skills-capable agent. However, nothing shows how the description is written or tuned to trigger at the right moment rather than misfire. Missing for 10: documentation of the engineered description/trigger wording, evidence of activation precision (no false or missed triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, installed skills trigger automatically from task context, with descriptions engineered so the agent activates the right skill at the right moment

citations.quote: Start a new session and ask for a logo; the agent picks the skill up from its description.
The skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md), so it works in any agent that supports skills
